title: Date and Time Types: TIMESTAMP vs. TIMESTAMPTZ
realWorldScenario: An e-commerce store operates across New York, London, and Tokyo. Order timestamps are becoming desynchronized during daylight saving transitions.
questionStatement: What is the difference between TIMESTAMP (without time zone) and TIMESTAMPTZ (with time zone) in PostgreSQL? Which should you use for audit and transaction records?
expectedConcepts: TIMESTAMPTZ converts to and stores UTC internally
TIMESTAMP without time zone lacks timezone awareness
Production best practice for audit logs
hints: Does TIMESTAMPTZ store a timezone name or convert to UTC?
